ANSWER (fallback aligner — NOT mafft --auto): MAFFT could not be made available (no binary on the machine; no network to install it, confirmed by a retry at execution time). Per the approved contingency, the ten files were aligned with a deterministic pure-Python progressive MSA fallback (BLOSUM62, affine gaps open 11/extend 1, UPGMA guide tree, sum-of-pairs profile-profile), then gap accounting was done exactly as planned. Under the primary pooled definition (all gap characters '-' and '.' — '.' count was zero — including terminal gaps, over all alignment cells of all 10 alignments):

  PRIMARY pooled gap percentage = 1167 gap characters / 14,976 alignment positions = 7.79% (7.7925%)

This number comes from the fallback aligner, not MAFFT; it is an approximation of the mafft --auto result, not identical to it. Secondary variants: mean per-alignment cell gap% = 7.45%; mean per-alignment column-level gap% (columns containing ≥1 gap / columns) = 15.14%.
